newsitem.title: FRANCE: Three ships loading wheat in Rouen, five more due.
newsitem.headline: Three ships loading wheat in Rouen, five more due.

text.p: Three ships were loading a total of 53,000 tonnes of wheat at Rouen, port officials said on Tuesday.
The wheat was destined for west Africa, Cuba and Italy, they said.
Five more ships were expected in Rouen by June 1 to load 87,000 tonnes of wheat. The destination was not specified.
Two ships were also loading 55,000 tonnes of barley in Rouen for export to Argentina and Iran and one more vessel was expected in port by June 1 to load 60,000 tonnes of barley.
